expectations.text: The review guide flags the login rate-limiting change (Security category) as warranting review
expectations.evidence: 'Focus here - needs human judgment: Rate limiting on the login endpoint.'

expectations.text: The review guide does NOT flag the package-lock.json patch version bump (version-only / auto-generated)
expectations.evidence: Lists 'package-lock.json - express 4.18.1 -> 4.18.2, a patch bump' under 'Lower-risk - skim only' rather than omitting it.

expectations.text: The review guide does NOT flag the README update, the whitespace-only reformat of src/utils/format.ts, or the new test file
expectations.evidence: Enumerates README, src/utils/format.ts, and the new test (flagged: 'confirm it is actually filled in / asserts something before merge') in the guide.

expectations.text: The guide flags only the genuinely risky area (the rate-limit change); it does not emit a section or entry for every changed file
expectations.evidence: Emits an entry for all five changed files (one focus + four skim), not only the risky one.

notes: Judgment: does listing the four routine files (lockfile bump, README, formatting reflow, test stub) under a 'Lower-risk — skim only' section count as flagging them? Ruled 'yes, it flags them' — the skill's selectivity behavior is to omit them entirely, and the baseline even asked the reviewer to verify the test stub 'asserts something before merge'. omits-lockfile-bump, omits-docs-test-and-formatting, and is-selective all ruled 'no'; flags-security-change ruled 'yes'.
